minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the Holmen Street stormwater and 43 Summer Street cannabis hearings to July 11; 494 Electric Ave site plan approved.
minutes.summary: The board approved the site plan for a new accessory structure at 494 Electric Avenue, then continued two hearings to July 11: a residential stormwater permit with a common-driveway interpretation dispute, and the first hearing on a cannabis retail special permit and site plan at 43 Summer Street. It also approved prior minutes, appointed an open space representative to the economic development committee, and agreed to take up common driveway bylaw language on July 25.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the site plan for a new accessory building at 494 Electric Avenue, behind El Forno, by roll call with all members in favor.
The board continued the first hearing on a cannabis retail special permit and site plan at 43 Summer Street to July 11; staff will prepare a draft decision for that date.
The Northfield Road / Holmen Street stormwater permit hearing was continued to July 11 so it can be heard with a pending ANR plan.
Staff will seek the building commissioner's interpretation of the common driveway bylaw for the next meeting.
The board appointed Anna Lockwood as open space representative to the economic development committee and agreed to discuss common driveway bylaw language on July 25.

why_it_matters: Neither the 43 Summer Street cannabis retail permit nor the Holmen Street stormwater permit was decided, so both remain open for neighbors to comment on at the July 11 hearings.
How the common driveway bylaw is read, and possibly rewritten, would govern how future driveways serving several homes are permitted in town.
watch_next: July 11 at 6:05 pm: continued hearings on 43 Summer Street and Holmen Street, with a draft decision on the cannabis permit.
July 25: board discussion of common driveway bylaw language, with examples from other communities.
